messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Elevated error rate on /v1/embeddings and /v1/text/generate since 09:35 UTC. Symptoms: 429/503 quota errors, users reporting sudden failures. Affected: hosted API and some Dedicated customers. Severity: P1. On-call: matt.

matt: I'm on it. any obvious recent rollouts?

suzanne: We did a staged rollout of ratecap-v2 this morning around 08:50 — changed exemption mapping + token-accounting refactor. Canary went to 5% only.

alex: Logs show spike in REJECTED by rl-service with reason=exemptions-missing for a subset of customer_tiers. Example: `{"customer_id":"acct_42","reason":"no_exemption","quota":0}`

jamie: Confirming, dedicated accounts that had explicit exemptions were treated as normal accounts after the config migration. Token counters also look off — token_usage reported negative deltas in some shards.

matt: Oof. that explains 429s and token-accounting drift. what's safest immediate mitigation? kill switch for ratecap-v2? rollback?

lia: We have a feature flag `feature/ratecap-v2-enabled` in LaunchDarkly. Flip will revert to previous limiter behavior. Can be done quickly.

matt: Let's flip the flag first, then consider rolling back the deploy if issues persist. lia, flip now and confirm.

lia: Doing it. flipping `feature/ratecap-v2-enabled` -> false (LD).

deploy-bot: Feature flag change recorded: feature/ratecap-v2-enabled set to false by lia at 09:41:02 UTC.

matt: Observability — check dashboards (rl/error-rate, api/5xx, token-accounting-errors) and watch backpressure.

alex: After LD flip: error-rate on embeddings dropped ~80% in 30s. Token-accounting errors still bubbling on 3 shards — looks like delayed queue processing.

incident-bot: Note: customer impact ongoing. Initial customers affected: acct_42, acct_207, acct_enterprise_x. Escalating to CS to notify impacted customers.

suzanne: Opening a scoped rollback PR now to revert the migration changes for token-accounting mapping. If flag flip holds, rollback can be scheduled for low-traffic window, but if residual token drift persists we should revert now.

matt: Prioritize safety. lia, please coordinate a targeted ping to the top 5 affected enterprise accounts and offer status. jamie, lia: collect traces for token counter state for those accounts.

lia: Messaging drafted: "We're investigating intermittent quota errors; mitigation applied by disabling a ratecap config. We will follow up with root cause and timeline." Sending now.

jamie: Log snippet (truncated):
```
[rl-shard-3] ERROR token-accounting: delta=-120 for acct_207 at 09:39:11
[rl-shard-3] WARN exemptions: lookup failed for acct_42, returned null
[proxy] 503 POST /v1/embeddings  -> rl-reject reason=quota_rejected
```

alex: Suggestion: in addition to disabling v2, we should rehydrate exemptions into rl-service from the previous serialized store to avoid any missing mapping until migration is fixed. That can be done as a fast config push.

matt: Good idea — do config push as a fixpack. jamie, can you assemble the previous exemptions dump? suzanne, if rollback isn't needed, apply the config push to add exemptions back into RL.

jamie: Assembling now; ETA 12 min.

ops-oncall: Noted: SLO alert triggered for embeddings error rate. Running an extended monitor for 30m.

suzanne: If anyone sees persistent negative token deltas, stop ingestion for affected shards and run a reconciliation script. I'll prepare the script.

lia: CS confirmed notifications sent to the three impacted enterprise accounts; one asked about SLA credits — flagging for finance/sales followup.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback job for ratecap-v2 initiated by suzanne at 09:55:14 UTC (canary -> 5% reverted).

matt: Update: initial flag flip reduced customer errors dramatically. jamie — what does reconciliation look like?

jamie: Reconciliation script will compute expected token counters and emit compensating updates; it needs a safe window and will be a read-repair style update. Will run in dry-run first and output a diff.

alex: While jamie runs dry-run, I'm prepping a small hotfix that fixes the exemptions lookup fallback and prevents negative deltas by clamping token counters in rl-service. If tests pass I can ship to canary.

matt: Prioritize the safe path: exemption rehydration config -> hotfix if still needed. Keep canary bandwidth low.

jamie: Dry-run results: for acct_207, predicted +860 tokens to rehydrate; for acct_42, exemptions missing for 12 sub-tenants. Diff attached to PR.

suzanne: Applying rehydration config now (k8s configmap apply + rl-service reload).

deploy-bot: Configmap applied by suzanne at 10:12:03 UTC. rl-service reloaded on all nodes.

alex: After rehydration, token-accounting errors cleared from shards within ~90s. No negative deltas visible now. Embeddings error rate at baseline.

matt: Excellent. Confirming mitigation: feature flag off, exemptions rehydrated. Is any further rollback required?

suzanne: We can keep the deploy rolled back to be safe. I'll close the PR merging ratecap-v2 until we've got a migration plan and stronger unit tests.

lia: CS updated customers with mitigation summary. One customer requested a timeline for permanent fix. I'll follow up with a targeted update tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 10:26 UTC — residual impact resolved, monitoring continues.

matt: Great work. Next steps/action items:
- suzanne: hold ratecap-v2 rollout, add migration integration tests, add canary verification that exemptions map is intact.
- alex: finalize hotfix PR that clamps token counters and add alerting on negative deltas.
- jamie: run full reconciliation job and create a verification dashboard for token-accounting health.
- lia: customer postmortem notes & notify enterprise accounts about remediation and credits if requested.

suzanne: I'll own postmortem writeup. assigning to eng-postmortems and will include timeline/logs.

matt: Handoff to follow shift — i'm toggling monitoring to 15m cadence and leaving this in watch. ops-oncall, you're primary until 14:00 UTC.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged, will monitor.

jamie: attaching link to dry-run diff and logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/1865/rl-dryrun-1865000000 (private link)

lia: Thanks team. closing thread once postmortem is posted. :thumbsup:
